# Business Objectives — PP20

## Desired outcomes

- Reduce avoidable cross-system reconciliation for an agreed pilot use case.
- Establish reusable, governed semantic interoperability rather than point-to-point translation.

## Objectives

- Select one domain data product and define accountable ownership.
- Demonstrate a measurable improvement against a baseline that has yet to be agreed.

## Constraints and trade-offs

- Start with one domain data product rather than enterprise-wide standardisation.
- Treat the supplied time and commercial figures as planning constraints, not validated targets.

## Validation questions

- Which use case, owner, and baseline will define pilot success?
